body.p: , completing 's "Not lowered in Phase 1" (only the computed node constructors are left, for Phase 3). src/xpath_lower.c, src/xpath_static.c; IR kinds, the evaluator and public headers are unchanged: each construct lowers to existing IR plus library calls, found by name like fn:root (find_builtin_function, now with a namespace); a missing one is UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE naming the gap.

item.p: for member / for key/value (XPath 4.0, 4.13.1): the binding collection is a MAP over the arrays or maps calling array:split or map:entries (their argument coercion gives the type error and accepts JNodes), then the ordinary MAP with the position slot, so positions count across all arrays or maps. The member is item?1; key and value are map:keys and map:items of the single-entry map. XQST0089 for equal key and value names and for a position variable named like a range variable.

Destructuring let (4.13.2): the value coerced to the declared type (default item(), or one array() / map(*); with a declared type also coerced to the single array or map), then fn:items-at(V, i), fn:subsequence(V, n) for the last of n, V?i, or V?name; a declared record type without the variable's field binds a RAISE of XPTY0004.

Dynamic node tests (4.7.5.3-4): the selector is lowered with an absent focus (reading it raises XPDY0002) and coerced to xs:anyAtomicType*; the step uses * of the axis's principal node kind, then a FILTER keeps a node when some selector item is fn:atomic-equal to one of its keys: fn:jkey of a JNode, fn:node-name and fn:local-name of an XNode.

The item axis (4.7.4): per origin, a CONDITIONAL on count(fn:jvalue(G)): two or more items, the child step; none, (); one, the child step from the array [jvalue(G)] (a map or array origin is a JTree root). Deviation: that JNode's parent is the wrapper array's JNode, not G, and it sorts after G's tree, so parent/ancestor identity and mixed document order differ from the specification (QT4 JAxes-370..372, 384, 387, 388). The faithful form needs an axis value in the evaluator (Proposed).

Constructor functions (4.5.1.3): find_function gives constructor entries the parameter $value as xs:anyAtomicType? := ., so keyword arguments (xs:int(value := '1')) name it and an arity-0 query finds the constructor with a parameterless signature: xs:int() casts the context value and xs:int#0 is a closure capturing it (body CAST).

Method calls (4.15.5): a link of the chain: MAP over M, the item coerced to map(*), ?N looked up and dynamically called with the map first; arguments lowered in the body with the outer focus (as "=!>"); a placeholder is XPST0003.

but with (4.15.4): a chain link: A coerced to record(), B to map(), map:merge((A, B), {'duplicates': 'use-last'}). Deviation: the merged map is not coerced to A's record type (the IR cannot name a type known only at run time); a later coercion checks the fields.

jnode() selectors (3.2.12): decimal and double literals, negative numbers ("-" and the digits, built in the type frame's scratch) and QName literals (the EQName; in no namespace the local name, the form the evaluator's cast reads).
The free-variable analysis sees every variable of a destructuring let (the former four-candidate limit is gone).

Measured (release, XP40): 23,698 to 24,206 passed, none lost; slice 198/198. prod-ForClause.map 7 to 56, .member 0 to 33, prod-LetClause 67 to 137, prod-MethodCall 0 to 12, misc-ConstructorKeywords 5 to 153, misc-FocusConstructors 5 to 153, prod-ButWithExpr 0 to 10 (the rest need fn:parts-of-dateTime). Dynamic node tests and the item axis wait for fn:jkey and fn:jvalue (2.17): with them prod-AxisStep.J goes 30 to 98 in a private run. prod-NamedFunctionRef's 72 failures are missing library functions, not references.
